scripts.dev: npm run build -w @shike/shared && npm run build -w @shike/server && concurrently -k -n shared,api-types,api,web -c gray,gray,green,cyan "npm run dev -w @shike/shared" "npm run build:watch -w @shike/server" "npm run dev -w @shike/server" "npm run dev -w @shike/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @shike/shared && npm run build -w @shike/server && npm run build -w @shike/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @shike/shared && npm run typecheck -w @shike/server && npm run typecheck -w @shike/web
